main:
One base, a week of easy doenjang jjigae 🍲

Make this savory Korean soybean paste mix once, then on busy nights just add water, tofu, zucchini, and onion. No separate anchovy stock needed.
reply1:
All-purpose doenjang base:
• 6 parts doenjang
• 1 part gochujang
• 1 part minced garlic
• 2 spoonfuls anchovy powder
• ½ spoonful sugar

Mix well and refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.
reply2: Stir 2 spoonfuls into 500 ml water with tofu, zucchini, and onion; simmer until tender. Anchovy powder adds depth without making stock. It also works in ssamjang.
